label: Teltonika TSW200
description: An industrial 8-port Gigabit switch with 802.3af/at PoE on every port - the first Teltonika switch with PoE on all eight.
notes: Vendor figures (Teltonika wiki and TSW200 v1 datasheet): eight Gigabit Ethernet ports supporting IEEE 802.3af and 802.3at PoE; datasheet port table states 8 x PoE ports.

poe.note: Datasheet (TSW200, 2024-v1.0), POE block, verbatim: "PoE ports Port 1 - 8"; "PoE standards 802.3af and 802.3at Alternative B" (v1.2 adds "Alternative A (From batch 42) / Alternative B (From batch 1-41)"); "PoE Max Power per Port (at PSE) 30 W"; "Total PoE Power Budget (at PSE) 240 W"; "Power consumption Idle: 1.81 W / Max: 5.5 W / PoE Max: 245.5 W". Eight 30 W ports sum to exactly the 240 W ceiling, the same full-fill arithmetic as its TSW100 sibling. Read 2026-11-20; the product page prints the same headline ("Total power budget at PSE up to 240 W", https://teltonika-networks.com/products/switches/tsw200).
